notes.title: Hot Fix #2 - Version 0.16.3.39735
notes.notes:
Hello Voyagers! We have an update out now that addresses some of the issues you've been experiencing. 

First, thank you so much for all of the helpful reports and patience as we get these bugs resolved! Now, on to the fixes:
Founder's Pack & Twitch Rewards Fix
We've implemented a partial fix for Founder's Pack Items and Twitch Rewards not being craftable in-game:

What's Working:

Founder's Pack and Twitch Rewards always work for the Host

Both should be craftable in single-player games and Dedicated Server games

Founder's Pack should be craftable in regularly hosted multiplayer games

Still Working On:

Twitch Rewards are currently NOT showing up for players joining regularly hosted multiplayer games

We're actively investigating this and hope to have a fix out soon
Direct Connect Feature
We've added a Direct Connect to IP feature for joining Dedicated Servers:

New button in the Server Browser opens a prompt to connect directly using IP and password

Known Issue:

If you enter the wrong password, you'll need to exit and restart the game. Type carefully!
Important for Dedicated Server Hosts
All Dedicated Servers must be restarted to get this update. Server and client versions must match for players to join successfully.



Check our Service Status Page for the latest updates.


What's Next
We are continuing to work on the above issues, and keeping an eye out for other urgent fixes!

We’ve got a bunch more streamers checking out the game as we go into our first launch weekend!

Voyagers of Nera is still 20% off for our launch discount

Dev stream next Thursday at 12pm PT where we'll share what's coming in our 2-week patch!

See you on the waves!

The Treehouse Team

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hello Voyagers!

Just 13 hours after Early Access, we’ve got our first hotfix patch going live RIGHT NOW. 

These are a few targeted fixes for bugs that players have been reporting during Launch Day.

Fixed an issue where Dedicated Servers could spawn less Sharks and Stalker enemies than intended

Instant Build does not properly pull from inventory even if the player has all of the materials

Clients (i.e. non-host players in multiplayer) would become unable to attack if they died while unarmed or with a spear

(BANDAID / TEMP FIX) Dedicated Server Browser now shows up to 200 entries

Note: We think there may still be more than 200 (vs previous: 10) active entries, but we are not 100% sure. Hopefully this will make it much more possible to find your server in the browser, but you may still need to filter + refresh a few times

We will have a part two fix coming near the end of the week to add Direct Connect via IP, assuming it passes testing

As a result of this patch, Dedicated Servers will need to update their version as well.



Thank you to everyone who’s been making our Early Access launch so special. Your feedback has helped us improve the game so much, and your excitement is contagious!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/2fdab58c49860d38543bd8a352fa13b66432cd7e.gif"]

Please keep your clips, feedback, and bug reports coming! 

And if you’re having a great time with the game, please consider leaving us a review on Steam - it’s a huge help for game discovery on Steam :)


See you on Thursday at 3pm PT for our Chill, Build, and AMA Twitch Stream!

- The Treehouse Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #24 - Early Access Update and The Greatwood Preview!
notes.notes:
Hello Voyagers! Michael / Spacenorth here with an important update about our Early Access timeline and some exciting progress to share.


Important Early Access Update
We're moving our Early Access launch date to September 16th.

As a small indie team, we want to make sure we're launching Voyagers when it has the best chance of reaching players. Our original launch date is right next to some (pretty dope) AAA releases that have marketing budgets we simply can't compete with, and pushing ahead then will lead to us getting lost in the noise.

On the plus side, this extra time lets us fix more bugs, polish features, and deliver the most awesome Early Access experience we can! We know delays are never fun news, but we're confident this extra time will result in a much stronger experience at launch.


Game Progress is Flying! 🚀
On the development side, we are taking advantage of the extra weeks! We just set up another playtest with our alpha testers featuring some major additions:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/3907becacaf1dfdf40204af7402eb8a610c6c53f.png"]
The Greatwood
Our third biome is taking shape! Alpha testers are now exploring an entirely new environment with:

New enemies called the Hunters that stalk and hunt you amongst the mangrove trees

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/ff220858f57e3ef328998ab6283cb44fd60872c2.gif"]

New resources and recipes to discover. A whole biome’s worth!

Completely different atmosphere from the first two biomes, with a vast magical forest to explore, traverse and sail through
More Improvements
Dedicated server support is progressing well - we'll have announcements about official hosting partners soon!

Loads of new graphics options to help the game run smoothly on more systems

New art assets making their way into the game regularly like this new Thatch Building Kit!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/601142db5e2e6779e7a753ee9e65bc3135d1013d.png"]
Thank You Playtesters! 
The feedback from these playtests continues to shape every aspect of development, and seeing players explore these new spaces for the first time never gets old. If you’re participating in these playtests, be sure to fill out the survey link in the Options Menu!


Quick Reminders 📅
We’re part of the Dames for Games show happening next week on July 17th to July 24th on twitch.tv/dames4games. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/78a458475416410f7bb663a5fd9c60380988eb8a.png"]

We’ve also got a new video at the Secret Sauce Game Showcase on Saturday July, 19th at 11am PT.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/6cc68658d5eb96ea6ad08fe22c52bfbb9f8cdb67.png"]

We’re also going to be at the Open Sauce 2025 Showcase in San Mateo from Friday, July 18 - Sunday, July 20 - if you'll be there, come say hi to the team!



Missed our recent dev stream about how the water in Nera works? 

Check it out here: Diving into Water Aesthetics in Voyagers of Nera! 
[previewyoutube="7GuBKyxPDVM;full"][/previewyoutube]Thank You
Your patience and support mean everything as we work toward the best possible Early Access launch. The extra development time is going directly into making Voyagers the game we all want it to be.

- Michael and the Treehouse Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #17 - Steam Demo Update #2 and Feedback
notes.notes:
Hello wonderful Voyagers! Michael / Spacenorth here with exciting updates and insights from last week’s Steam Demo Update!

Demo Build Refreshed!

We've just updated the version of the game available on Steam with a wave of new features focused on oceanic adventure:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/7e7be7c2514464e79f7dfcc16205026b923d2d2e.gif


 Exciting new underwater spaces to explore and resources to find
 Improved boat and swimming mechanics and feel
 Terrifying monsters lurking beneath the waves like a huge shark and even bigger deep sea Stalker
 A sneak peek at our Second Biome (from a distance)
 New crafting stations, inventory system improvements and so much more!


Check out the full patch notes here for all the details.

Want to see EVEN MORE of what we're working on? Sign up for our Discord playtests [here] and join our email Newsletter [here] to get early access to experimental features! 

Feedback from the Latest Update

Your feedback is the compass that guides our development, and we've been analyzing the themes emerging from your latest comments:
 
Ocean & Water: Making Waves!

Our main focus for the past milestone was enhancing the ocean experience, and your feedback shows it's paying off:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/ee4a834ae000f0f28717e21fe191e51db63cec1d.gif


 Underwater spaces feel more interesting and rewarding to explore
 Ocean enemies have added much-needed variety and some terrifying moments


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/78d785e20873f34bae753abc7af227310ee416aa.gif

Here are a couple of favorite moments EVER: 

 Seeing the Stalker for the first time: TisSarahBarah - what lurks in the storm . . . 
 Volume Warning - Stalker appears underwater! TisSarahBarah - scweam  
 Sailing and exploration have become more engaging
 Surfing remains the a stand-out fan favorite feature


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/653e8b0aa02788ec190699902f9bbe1eaba450a4.gif

We've noticed a few comments about looking for easier solo boat play, but they're quite rare. We'll keep monitoring this area as we continue to refine the experience.

Combat: Getting Sharper

The combat system continues to evolve:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/8f2ce2bf7f52d3e1296936d2652883127e40645f.gif


 Increased enemy variety has made encounters more dynamic 
 Mechanics are smoother, though still overall (intentionally) straightforward 
 While we don't plan to make combat overly complex, we do want to give you more tactical options
 Look for new combat abilities coming soon through spirit companions!



Hunger & Attrition: Finding Balance

The survival mechanics are improving, but still need work:


 The system feels less punishing than before
 Overall clarity has improved significantly
 Still seeing feedback that hunger leans toward being an annoyance
 More tuning is on the way – we'll keep refining this!


The Reef: A New Horizon (Discord Playtest Group)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/7091eda4c2d8e74bd6679e0ebf5f4d69fd33ec9c.gif

The feedback on our second biome has been invaluable:


 Players are noting how different it feels from the Embrace – exactly what we were aiming for!
 Each biome should feel like a truly unique place to explore
 We're considering ways to give Steam demo players a sneak peek... perhaps during the upcoming Steam NextFest in June?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/ef527584a10d8f90fdc0695e3403e095d94a2804.gif

Thank you for continuing to share your thoughts and experiences. Every comment helps us shape Voyagers into the magical adventure we all want it to be!

We're excited for you to continue to set sail with us!

- Michael and the Treehouse Team

notes.title: Demo Update! – Ships & Sea Monsters
notes.notes:
Hey Voyagers! It's Michael (Spacenorth) here with the latest update to our demo! 

We heard your feedback loud and clear—while video updates are great, many of you also appreciate having a written breakdown of the changes. So, alongside our usual video updates, we’re bringing you a detailed written recap to keep everyone in the loop. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[previewyoutube=Rn6wufTvTqI;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Important Update Note

Before we dive into the details, a quick heads-up: when the patch goes live on the demo, your save data will be wiped. Be sure to save any progress in the demo locally through screenshots and video recordings, otherwise you will not be able to access it. 

Revamped: The Embrace

The first biome, The Embrace, has undergone significant changes, including a complete overhaul of its enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/04930d9c2bf749d5c9c90c236a629da4ba0ff504.gif

 New Enemy Type – The Shattered: These are enraged beings made of corrupted Mana. Defeating them will reward you with Mana, which is essential for crafting.
 Relocated Enemies: The previous enemies of The Embrace have now been moved to the second biome, The Reef.
 Revamped Ancient Ruins: To complete the first biome, players must explore three newly redesigned ancient ruins, battle ancient constructs, and recover a fragment of the Elder Spirit of the Ocean.
 Updated Quests: The quest system has been refined to guide players more effectively through these new changes.



Major Ocean Gameplay Enhancements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/874402ca95e84d2f5568f90a140fd5b0f9f757cb.gif
The latest update brings a host of improvements to the game’s ocean exploration:


 New Ship – The Cargo Skiff: This new vessel expands your options for sea travel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/b987987ac073c4aac5c119eb3465762a2df2e0db.gif
 Speed UI: Players can now monitor their sailing speed with a brand-new user interface.
 Enhanced Camera & Physics: Ships now bob more realistically on waves, improving immersion.
 Inventory Protection: If a ship sinks, a floating chest will appear, holding all lost inventory items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/59bcec7988611bb03d68b9e5d184dfa07353f7ba.gif
Underwater Exploration Overhaul
Underwater gameplay has been refined to provide a smoother, more immersive experience.

Improved Combat: Spear combat is now more fluid and easier to aim.
Underwater Dash: Players can now dodge and juke enemies using an underwater dash move.
Spear Fishing: A new mechanic that allows players to hunt fish as a primary food source.
Enhanced Environment: The ocean floor is now more lush, dynamic, and visually engaging.
 More Oxygen: Increased oxygen availability makes underwater exploration more accessible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/ed9e0e7c922b9cb0136ca8c1c5e6b115cae92995.gif
Terrifying New Creatures
Giant Deepling Sharks:These massive predators patrol deep waters, and will keep you on the edge. 
Bioluminescent Stalkers: Found at the biome’s furthest edges, these creatures can hunt you and ships, with a preference for attacking swimmers first!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/dfc871c4b90293b20f7d8597d5c082249309fa3f.gif

New Gameplay Features & Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/9e82e5e1a8c382599fc361b86574aaffa6654d8d.gif
Beyond the biome and ocean changes, the update introduces several quality-of-life enhancements:

 Inventory Upgrades: New Take All and Store Like Items buttons streamline inventory management.
 Craftable Armor: Players can now build protective gear, both for function and aesthetic appeal.
New Crafting Stations:
 Imbuing Bench: Upgrade armor for enhanced defense.
 Mana Forge: Craft magical trinkets, including those that boost oxygen capacity.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/6c5c9f576ba684b785404814e5e864da9e6b7f05.gif
 Trash Management: Inspired by a suggestion from Discord users Sublime and MrMeeko, the cute Bullwog now serves as a trash can for discarding unwanted items.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/c0c344086f8c5893c6f2fe97576a39ee2f94b3ee.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/b5b8aa28cdfcc9ccff8ed25830c366d68a2cb1c8.png
Credits to Sublime and MrMeeko for sharing these ideas with us in our Discord! 

A Glimpse at the Second Biome – The Reef
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/9dd0ec7dc0c6ce157a793620acf68203330ee286.gif
Although not fully available in the demo, The Reef promises to be a breathtaking new adventure.


 Massive Coral Cliffs: Towering reef formations create new vertical exploration opportunities.
 Glider & Air Geysers: Players can use these to soar high above the ocean.
 Expansive Underwater Exploration: More secrets and creatures await in the deep.
 Deadly Purple Death Zones: Corruption spreads through these hazardous areas filled with dangerous monsters.
 Deep Link Spires: Mysterious sources of corruption lie beneath the ocean and must be found and destroyed.


While this biome isn’t yet accessible in the Steam demo, regular updates and testing opportunities are available through the game’s Discord community.

Join the Community & Stay Updated
Our team actively seeks feedback from all our passionate players. If you want early access to future updates and want to help shape the game, consider joining our Discord community or our playtests!

We are coming out with new playtest builds every two weeks (unless other notified) so there’s always something new to discover. We will continue doing patch updates here on Steam when we have a new playtest build. Our team values all of your feedback and looks forward to hearing your thoughts!

Hope you have fun! And don't forget to wishlist and invite your friends along for the journey! 
- Michael and Treehouse Games

notes.title: February Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Voyagers, it's Michael (Spacenorth) here! 

We're thrilled to share our first major update to the Steam demo! These past few two months have been incredibly busy as we've been implementing so many changes based on your amazing feedback.

From completely reworking our hunger system to enhancing combat mechanics, improving nighttime gameplay, and adding long-requested features like key rebinding and an unstuck system - this update touches a ton of the game. We've also made substantial improvements to crafting interfaces and added plenty of visual polish across the board.

As we continue to develop the demo, we are still making foundational changes to the game. This means we will be wiping save data between each update. If you would like to keep a memory of your Nera, we recommend taking a video and sharing your final screenshots before you update the game. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

For this update, we're trying something new - video patch notes! We thought it would be fun to show rather than just tell you about all these changes. Check out the video to see these improvements in action and get a closer look at some of the visual updates we've made to the ocean, character animations, and environmental effects.

[previewyoutube=tOlAgbDRzYw;full][/previewyoutube]

Let us know what you think about this format! We're always looking to improve how we communicate changes with our community. Is there anything specific you'd like to see in future patch note videos?

We can't wait to hear your thoughts on all these changes. If you’ve played, please share your thoughts in our survey and through our FeatureUpvote board!

Also, a quick reminder that this Thursday at 12PM PT, we will be showcasing our first official biome, The Reef with our Producer, Steph, our World Design Director, Christina and Senior Environmental Artist, Kyle.  Stay tuned on twitch.tv/Voyagers of Nera. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/993bd74cb1d95c61cf59ce68010b4e5bb7b819ef.png

As always, thank you for your feedback and support as we keep adding more to Voyagers!

See you on the waves! 🌊 

- Michael and the Treehouse Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #2 - August Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/80aaed93e959742113b79784d5d1a6b5ca3b83f1.jpgAhoy Voyagers! Michael / Spacenorth here again to share the latest news on Voyagers of Nera!

Over the last couple months, we’ve been putting a lot more work into one of the most critical pillars of the game: sailing through a magical ocean world. 

From the very start of the game, you will see mysterious islands and distant biomes that you will one day visit. We think one of the best part of all survival crafting games is getting to see a new world, and that’s an extra important part of the fantasy in our game. You’re here to sail boldly into the unknown, ready to reveal what this magical ocean world has to offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/6b0ae0b194667b040cb2ac136bd8ccdc44325d9a.png

Naturally, in Voyagers of Nera, all of these places to visit, from ancient ruins deep underwater to the remnants of long-gone stone behemoths to massive oversized mangroves are all separated by big stretches of dangerous open ocean. Sometimes these trips are serene and relaxed, and other times they’re deadly - you’ll have to skillfully sail, skim, and scrap to stop your ship from sinking! We went into some more detail with a quick look at combat mechanics in our most recent dev stream - here’s the link if you want to see more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/9305d0ce14b720e5affd90de4ab886f27361064a.gif

Lastly, thank you so much for all the new playtester volunteers. We nearly doubled our playtester pool since our last dev blog and we can’t tell you how much we appreciate your interest! If you haven’t signed up yet, it’s not too late: SIGN UP HERE. And if you didn’t get into this playtest, don’t worry! We are playtesting every few weeks and can’t wait to get more players into the mix and hear your feedback.

That’s all for now - hope to see you in our Discord or at our next dev stream this Thursday, August 8th at 5pm PT!

- Michael and the Treehouse Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #1 - July Update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all future Voyagers! 

I’m Michael aka “Spacenorth”, cofounder and CEO at Treehouse. Today, I’m excited to share some updates about Voyagers of Nera and send out the call for playtesters!

We were thrilled to finally announce our game and trailer with you back in December at Wholesome Snack, and it was incredible to see so much interest in Voyagers from across the world! PCGamer (EN), Warlegend (FR), Gamebase (CN) to shoutout just a few. 

Right after the announcement, we went heads down again to keep on building, playtesting and iterating on the game. We’ve been crafting a new biome to explore, dangers to encounter at sea, underwater spaces to explore, and of course, big iterations to core systems thanks to the feedback of our early playtesters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/4aaae76b0e0150f8288923857e1373cab094ac2e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779674/cc444f007981a5b013ff4fbb0a85bde19a97808c.png

With all the progress we’ve been making on Voyagers, we’ve been feeling like there’s a big backlog of fun and juicy content that we want to start sharing! In our community Discord, we’ve been sharing some sneak peek videos and we just started a Developer stream for a more casual, direct way to talk with the community. Here’s a VOD to our first stream, and check out new ones every other Thursday at 5pm PT in our Discord (including this Thursday)!

Today, we are also looking for YOUR HELP. We’ve always believed that great games require lots of player feedback and lots of iteration. We’ve been super lucky to have a group of passionate, dedicated playtesters that have been helping us make the game better and better over the last few months. Now it’s time to start growing that playtester group! 

If you love survival crafting games and are excited to play early builds, provide feedback, and catch bugs, then we’d love to have you join our Alpha Playtester group. Please sign up here (LINK) and we will reach out with details. We will be playtesting fresh builds every few weeks and plan to add new players into every one!

Thank you so much for checking out our page and showing your interest in Voyagers of Nera. We can’t wait to share more soon! 

- Michael and the Treehouse team
